item.title: Study advances understanding of tick-borne Powassan virus
item.description: Expanding tick populations across the U.S. are driving up tick-borne diseases, including Powassan virus, a rare but increasingly reported infection.

item.title: Cystic fibrosis triple therapy found especially effective in early childhood
item.description: Cystic fibrosis is an incurable genetic disorder. Since 2020, triple therapy has targeted its underlying cause, with researchers examining its effects.

item.title: Salaried roles may now carry more risk for doctors [PODCAST]
item.description: Subscribe to The Podcast by KevinMD. Watch on YouTube. Catch up on old episodes! An eye surgeon who once saw forty patients a day now sees far fewer.

item.title: AI tool shows high diagnostic accuracy for identifying and predicting sepsis
item.description: Bhargava and colleagues evaluated an AI tool's ability to identify sepsis at presentation in adults with suspected infection, with promising results.
